yana (Quiver): Hey team — onboarding smoke test failing: our SPA initializes 24 embed widgets and we see intermittent 429s from the edge during first load. Any quick wins?

maria (CS): Hi Yana — are you using ephemeral tokens or a server key? Can you paste a failing response body?

yana (Quiver): Using ephemeral tokens minted per-session (TTL 20s). Sample: `429 {"message":"rate limit", "retry_after": 7}`. Happens only on cold page loads with many simultaneous users.

josh (Eng): 20s TTL + 24 widgets -> token churn. Quick mitigations: increase TTL to 60s, or have backend mint one token per page and pass to client. Also debounce widget inits into a single `redwood.init()` promise.

rahul (SRE): We can apply a short scoped quota bump for Quiver in the region for 24h while you fix. Want me to do that?

yana (Quiver): Yes please, thanks. We'll implement debounce + jitter today and deploy.

maria (CS): I'll open a KB placeholder with reproduction and mitigations. Note: SDK v1.4+ supports `init_concurrency_limit` and `single_preflight` flags you can toggle client-side.

josh (Eng): We'll ship a tiny patch that sets `init_concurrency_limit: 6` and randomized jitter 100-500ms before preflight. Also adding a local cache so multiple widgets reuse the same preflight result.

rahul (SRE): Scoped bump applied (org=quiver, region=us-west) at 3130000100 for 24h. Enabled trace logs for preflight events.

yana (Quiver): Patch rolled, TTL bumped to 60s in staging, running load test now. Early results: 429s dropped ~90%. We'll monitor metrics in Console. Thanks all.

bot-deploy: deploy quiver/frontend@3130000200 succeeded

maria (CS): Follow-up: I'll add KB and a short email template you can send to your infra team summarizing changes. Will post links in this thread. :thumbsup:
